exposure: Time from PPROM to delivery (< 48 hours or >= 48 hours)
outcome: Factors predictive of PPROM delivered > 48 hours
cohort: The study included 519 pregnant women with a singleton pregnancy complicated by PPROM between 34 0/7 and 36 6/7 weeks of gestation, who had planned expectant management.
finding: Clinical predictors for PPROM delivered > 48 hrs were maternal age (>= 19 years was protective) and presence of oligohydramnios (increased likelihood).
birth_weight: Observed mean neonatal birth weights were 2245 g for the >48 hours group and 2490 g for the <48 hours group.
